slides.title: The Transformers Library
slides.content:
# NLP Democratized 🤗

Provides thousands of pre-trained models (BERT, GPT, RoBERTa) easy to use.

## The Pipeline API
The highest level abstraction. Zero code model usage.

```python
from transformers import pipeline

classifier = pipeline("sentiment-analysis")
res = classifier("I love this movie!")
# [{'label': 'POSITIVE', 'score': 0.99}]
```

slides.title: Tokenizers
slides.content:
# Tokenization ✂️

Models don't understand text strings. Tokenizers convert text into number IDs the model was trained on.

```python
from transformers import AutoTokenizer

tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("bert-base-uncased")
inputs = tokenizer("Hello world", return_tensors="pt")
# Input IDs: [101, 7592, 2088, 102]
```

slides.title: Fine-Tuning
slides.content:
# Using Pre-trained Models 🔧

Don't train from scratch! Take a model trained on billions of words (like BERT) and fine-tune it on your specific small dataset.

## The `Trainer` API
Handles the training loop (epochs, batches, saving) for you.
```python
trainer = Trainer(
    model=model,
    args=training_args,
    train_dataset=small_train_dataset,
    eval_dataset=small_eval_dataset
)
trainer.train()
```
